        <footnote id="F3">These securities are held directly by OrbiMed Israel Partners II, L.P. (&quot;OIP II&quot;). OrbiMed Israel GP II, L.P. (&quot;Israel GP&quot;) is the general partner of OIP II. OrbiMed Advisors Israel II Limited (&quot;Advisors Israel&quot;) is the general partner of Israel GP. By virtue of such relationships, Israel GP and Advisors Israel may be deemed to have voting power and investment power over the securities held by OIP II and as a result, may be deemed to have beneficial ownership over such securities. Advisors Israel exercises this investment and voting power through a management committee comprised of Carl L. Gordon, David P. Bonita, and the Reporting Person, each of whom disclaims beneficial ownership of the shares held by OIP II.</footnote>
        <footnote id="F4">Each of the Reporting Person, Israel GP, and Advisors Israel disclaims beneficial ownership of the securities reported herein for purposes of Rule 16a-1(a) under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the &quot;Exchange Act&quot;), except to the extent of its pecuniary interest therein, if any. This report shall not be deemed an admission that any of such entity or person is a beneficial owner of such securities for purposes of Section 16 of the Exchange Act, or for any other purpose.</footnote>
